_comment: Paywall « débloquer le cours en cours de lecture » (maquette). Même direction que manifest-poster.json : aplats en papier découpé, marine, safran, corail, crème.

items.name: pw_hero_nuit_etoilee
items.prompt: An open book lying flat; from its pages rises a swirling night sky with big spiral swirls, a glowing crescent moon, round stars and a tall dark flame-shaped cypress tree. A ribbon bookmark hangs from the middle of the book. Flat poster illustration, paper-cut shapes, limited palette of deep navy blue, saffron yellow, coral red and cream, bold simple forms, subtle paper grain, centered on a cream background, no text, no outlines.
